runs2.parquet: one row per run: resolved config, `cell` (hash without seed), `blocks` (study-2 blocks containing the config), every metric of stein.train.evaluate (lists JSON-encoded)
cells2.parquet: one row per config over seeds: mean and 95% seed-bootstrap CI (`_lo`, `_hi`) of METRICS
thresholds.parquet: one row per setting x estimator: lam_hat (censor '<'/'>' when outside the grid), bootstrap CI lo/hi (+-inf draws when censored), metric, tau, upward
frontier.parquet: best mean content R^2 over the lambda path subject to mean leak_r2 <= ceiling, with CI
verdicts.json: written by stein/verdicts2.py: the statistic behind each pre-registered prediction P1-P17 (lambda_hat ratios with bootstrap CIs, E3/E4/E5 contrasts, leakage at matched content R^2)

metrics.leak_r2 / content_r2: linear ridge probe R^2 (mean over code dims), held out
metrics.nuis_share / content_share: fraction of total embedding variance explained by OLS on the linear nuisance / content code, held out (raw units)
metrics.*_share_oh: same with one-hot factor levels (additive per factor)
metrics.unexpl_share(_oh): 1 - joint share of content and nuisance codes
metrics.nuis_eigs / content_eigs: eigenvalues of the covariance of the code-explained part of z
metrics.nuis_dir_ratio: mean of the top min(5, d-6) nuis_eigs / mean of the top min(6, d) content_eigs (theory: v = 1 - lam*/lam)
metrics.pc_var / pc_nuis_var / pc_content_var: variance along the embedding's principal axes, total and explained by each code
metrics.mcc / mcc_per: mean |corr| between embedding coordinates and the 6 content code dims after Hungarian matching; per code dim (cos hue, sin hue, scale, shape simplex x3)
